newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S. T-bond extends losses in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: U.S. T-bond extends losses in Tokyo.

text.p: The key 30-year U.S. Treasury bond extended losses by late Tokyo afternoon trade due to light speculative sales. But activity was thin before payroll data due for release at 1330 GMT, traders said.

The speculative sales weighed on prices in the afternoon on growing concerns that Japanese investors may take further profits from Treasuries to offset their losses from tumbling domestic stock prices ahead of book closings this fiscal year, they said. "Speculation is growing, but actual sales have not emerged today. Operators are taking a wait-and-see stance," a brokerage trader said.
